title: Returns Window
body: Customers in North America may return any unworn or unopened item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Electronics carry a 14-day window.

title: Refund Method
body: Refunds in North America are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of return receipt.

title: Shipping Damage
body: If an item arrived damaged, photograph the damage and contact support within 7 days. Replacements ship within 2 business days at no cost.

title: Cancellation
body: Orders may be cancelled at no charge until they enter the 'shipped' status. After shipment, follow the standard returns process.

title: Escalation Threshold
body: Any refund request above $200 USD must be reviewed by a human agent. The agent should call escalate_to_human in such cases.

title: Address Change
body: Shipping address updates are accepted for orders in 'processing' status only; once shipped the address is locked.
